Both sides are resolved before comparison (Path.resolve() on file and root, is_relative_to), and the test matrix pins absolute/traversal/external-symlink/dangling cases so the suite proves it in its own environment.

Scope discipline: it is a different verb with different output semantics; ledgered as a deferral with a revisit trigger instead of riding this bounded stage.
